title: Annotatio V §.I: Limits taken Materially (articles) or Formally (the act of limiting)
pass_a_gloss: So understood, they are taken either Materially, for the things or Articles of the Christian Religion that justly limit Ecclesiastical Consociation, or reduce it to just bounds and keep it within them; or Formally, for the limitation itself, or the act of limiting in its various degree.
pass_b_english: Taken that way, limits are either Material — the things or articles of the Christian religion that justly bound church consociation and keep it inside those bounds —
or Formal — the limitation itself, the act of limiting in its various degrees.
source_text: Ita verò intellecti, vel sumuntur Materialiter, pro rebus, seu Articulis Christ. Religionis, Consociationem Ecclesiasticam juste limitantibus, seu ad justos terminos redigentibus, intraque eosdem continentibus; vel Formaliter pro limitatione ipsâ, seu actu limitandi vario graduque.
